name: transaction-sandbox
description: Writable staging database sandbox. Always rolls back — production data never modified. SET LOCAL app.sandbox_mode = true on every connection.

tools.name: begin_sandbox
tools.description: Open an explicit BEGIN transaction on the staging database. Returns a session_id for subsequent calls. Sets sandbox_mode=true and statement_timeout=5000ms.

tools.name: execute_in_sandbox
tools.description: Execute SQL inside the open sandbox transaction. Statement timeout is enforced at 5000ms.

tools.name: capture_diff
tools.description: Capture row counts for a list of tables. Returns key 'table_counts'. Call with phase='pre' before execute and phase='post' after.

tools.name: get_trigger_log
tools.description: Read sandbox_trigger_log entries for this session. Returns key 'trigger_log'.

tools.name: rollback_sandbox
tools.description: ROLLBACK the sandbox transaction and close the connection. Always called — even on error.
